en: A sepia-toned postcard depicting a large hydroelectric power station constructed in a grand architectural style, straddling a powerful river with rapids or waterfalls. The landscape around the structure is forested and slightly hilly, with a cliff edge visible on the left. There is a prominent dam-like building with large arched windows, and above it a longer, castle-like facility. The text, which is in Swedish, appears in the sky area of the card.
